notes.success_24h: % of requests in the last 24 h that did not fail on Ezkielyna's or the upstream's side (5xx); same rule as https://api.ezkielyna.store/status
notes.ttft_ms: time to first token of streamed answers, median and 90th percentile, last 24 h
notes.tps: output tokens per second of streamed answers with >= 50 output tokens and >= 2 s of generation, median, last 24 h (estimate: the gateway logs total time in whole seconds)
notes.requests: answers counted in each window (show uptime only when the window has enough requests)
notes.low_data: fewer than 20 answers in 24 h: latency and speed are not shown
